conclusion.recommendation: Preserve the actual historical output-stop trip and v9/incomplete outcomes. Deliberately record a finite prospective output-guard amendment for new work within the unchanged actual campaign resource/account envelope, then continue remaining useful target work through supported admission controls. Do not silently ignore or edit the old threshold; do not resume frozen/running assignments under enlarged caps.

concrete_amendment_requirements: Add a new immutable prospective policy record naming its effective UTC/version boundary, this assessment, the exact user-handoff pin, old threshold and observed crossing; label the new numeric output allocation operator-selected, never a quoted user amendment.

Declare one finite cumulative observed-output lower-bound stop and warning for future admissions, plus bounded per-job allocations and named evaluation/publication reserves, chosen from planned remaining stages and available time. These authority sources alone do not justify a particular replacement token number.

Do not rewrite AUTHORIZATION.json, the installed historical receipt, v9 cap/birth/exit126, S8 incomplete outcomes, completed grades, old starts, per-job output values, or reservations belonging to frozen/running assignments.

Apply the successor policy only to prospectively frozen/new jobs or properly recorded replacements. Keep previous failed/interrupted attempts and their costs, and retain fresh same-family critic/evaluation requirements.

Preserve campaign-wide counting from original start, adjusted deadline only for genuinely authorized pauses, <=144 starts, <=172800 occupied seconds, <=2 active candidates per family, actual accepted helper concurrency, existing subscriptions, and platform/account permission controls.

Use the supported reviewed admission/accounting path; never suppress output observations, zero counters, clamp old counts, or fabricate quiescence. Check known starts, occupied commitments and time before admission. Stop at a real global ceiling, user stop, actual account/platform denial, or no safe useful work.
cost_and_safety_limits: Candidate generated output is a monotonic observed lower bound, not exact provider usage or money. Missing stage metrics and helper output remain outside that candidate numerical sum; unknown actual total must remain UNKNOWN.
The historical guard was a useful cost/rate/usefulness precaution. Broad execution authorization is not permission for purchases, paid API fallback, account-limit bypass or unbounded generation.

A finite replacement guard is supplemental engineering protection, not proof that actual provider consumption is below its number. When otherwise-safe remaining allowance is defensible, missing telemetry alone does not invent a new permission gate.

This review did not observe accounts, native quiescence, leases, permits, current accounting, actual pause evidence, or scheduler selection. Root must rely on its reconciled positive evidence rather than treat this authority judgment as runtime certification.
judgment_kind: Reasoned narrow authorization assessment; not a mandatory constitutional ruling or full campaign compliance certificate.

reasoning.claim: The 1,200,000 warning and 1,500,000 stop exist, but their authority file labels the selection conservative/prospective and contains no quoted user instruction imposing those numbers. The quoted user authorization concerns broad authorization and model roles. This does not by itself prove every numeric field lacks user provenance; the newer handoff resolves the practical interpretation.

The user-supplied handoff requires continued execution, permits ordinary engineering without routine Go, identifies agent-authored restrictive defaults as distinct from user instructions, and permits sensible prospective future-job allocations within the whole envelope. Its governing resource table names 12 hours, 144 starts, 172800 occupied seconds and existing subscriptions; it does not name an output-token ceiling.

Omission of output cap from the recovery amendment is not itself a recorded deletion of the old output guard. The installed historical receipt still reports output-warning/stop fields, so the current trip should remain a valid historical operational event until a deliberate successor policy is declared. No automatic increases is compatible with requiring explicit operator action instead of automatic escalation; it does not supply a later user ban on prospective engineering changes.

The permission to declare future allocations does not alter frozen/running assignment limits, births, failures, grades or measured usage. Replacement attempts retain their own identities and count, and unfinished targets cannot become complete retroactively.

The custom threshold described by the source-only mechanics review is a prospective admission/start-permit guard, not a provider permission denial or active-Goal cancellation mechanism. Its actual trip is not evidence of a user stop or independently established provider safety boundary. That source review does not certify which exact live closure is selected.

root_supplied_context_not_independently_.context_limit: Current counts, deadline/pause adjustment, and newer helper instruction were supplied by root rather than independently read. Arithmetic headroom does not promise target completion or prove safe admission.
